title: Common-stage pullback map representation
statement: For a scheme map $k:V\to W$, common-stage objects $M,N$ over $W$, a stage $L$ containing both stages and an arrow $s:M_L\to N_L$ at stage $L$, the common-stage pullback of the pair-category arrow represented by $s$ at $L$ is (up to the literal object equalities) the arrow represented at $L$ by $c_N^{-1}\circ k^*_L(s)\circ c_M$, where $c$ are the recorded pullback comparison isomorphisms of [def-weil-common-stage-pullback-data].

proof.text: This is the representative clause of the defining existence-and-uniqueness statement of common-stage pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], applied to the chosen functor.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageDerivedPullback_map_representation
    {V W : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W)
    [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (M N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω W)
    (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω)
    (hM : M.stage ≤ L) (hN : N.stage ≤ L)
    (s : M.toStage hM ⟶ N.toStage hN) :
    HEq ((commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω k).map
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.ofHom M N L hM hN s))
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.ofHom
        (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω k M) (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω k N)
        L hM hN
        ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω k M L hM).hom ≫
          (rationalDerivedPullback l
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) k).map s ≫
          (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω k N L hN).inv))
